text: Provides a Pathways API to create and manage conversation pathways programmatically
quote: See the Pathways API reference to create and manage pathways programmatically.

text: Can promote a pathway version to staging and test it before it goes live
quote: You can also promote a version to staging to test it before it goes live, or send an individual call against a specific

text: Lets users bring their own Twilio account and port existing phone numbers into the platform
quote: Users can connect their own Twilio account to Bland, easily bring over your existing phone numbers to use within the platform.

text: API integration lets the AI agent call any HTTP endpoint during a conversation
quote: The API integration lets you connect your AI agent to any HTTP endpoint.

text: Sends post-call webhook notifications automatically after each call completes
quote: Post-call webhooks are HTTP notifications that Bland AI automatically sends to your server after a phone call completes.

text: Batch calling lets you launch high-volume outbound campaigns by uploading a CSV of recipients
quote: Batch calls let you initiate high-volume call campaigns by uploading a list of recipients via CSV.

text: Evals let you grade call quality using LLM judges across defined dimensions
quote: Evals let you measure the quality of your calls with LLM judges. You define eval agents, each of which grades one dimension of a call

text: Testbed lets you isolate a specific node from a real or test call, edit the prompt, and re-run it repeatedly to see output variance
quote: The testbed lets you take any call — whether it's a historical call from call logs or a test chat from the pathway editor — isolate a specific node interaction, edit the prompt, and run it multiple times to see how the output varies.

text: Memory lets agents remember callers across calls, SMS, and other channels for continuity
quote: Memory lets Bland agents remember people across conversations, including calls, SMS, and other channels, so each interaction feels continuous and personalized.

text: Custom voice cloning from a ~10 second clean sample, with sample quality capping voice quality
quote: A clone needs one clean sample of about ten seconds. Quality of the sample sets the ceiling on quality of the voice

text: Official MCP server lets AI coding agents place/inspect calls, build pathways, manage agents, query analytics, run evals, and search docs via natural language
quote: The Bland MCP server lets AI coding agents work with your Bland account through natural language: place and inspect calls, build and validate pathways, manage agents, query analytics, run evals, and search the Bland docs

text: Official CLI lets you manage the entire Bland account from the terminal (calls, pathways, numbers, etc.)
quote: Manage your entire Bland account from the terminal: make calls, build and test pathways, configure phone numbers, and more.

text: Official SDK lets you embed a Bland voice agent into web apps (React/Vanilla JS/Node) with secure server-side auth
quote: Embed a Bland voice agent into any web application (React, Vanilla JS, or Node). The SDK handles secure authentication between your server and Bland, so your API key is never exposed to the browser.

text: Customers choose when to adopt a new platform release; infrastructure stays pinned to the chosen version
quote: You choose when to adopt a new release. Your infrastructure stays on the version you've selected until you decide to move forward.

text: Supports number porting to bring existing phone numbers onto Bland
quote: Number porting to bring existing numbers to Bland

text: Supports inbound and outbound SIP trunking to/from your own carrier or PBX
quote: Bland supports inbound and outbound SIP. Point calls from your carrier or PBX at Bland to be answered by an agent, or have Bland place calls out through your SIP provider.

text: Conversational Pathways let you visually design multi-step conversation flows with per-node instructions
quote: Conversational pathways are our new way of prompting Bland that has led to major breakthroughs in realism. Give your agent instructions on how it should respond at specific points of the conversation.

text: Pathway edits create a draft version; live calls keep using the published production version until promoted
quote: When you edit a pathway, you are working on a draft. Live calls are not affected. They keep using the published production version.

text: Supports A/B testing a new agent release against the live production version using real calls before full rollout
quote: This is how you A/B test a new agent release against your live production version, with real calls, before committing to a full rollout.

text: Can dispatch outbound AI phone calls to customers and leads to streamline operations
quote: Dispatch AI phone calls to call customers, leads, and to streamline operations.

text: Can create inbound phone numbers for use cases like customer support
quote: Create inbound phone numbers for customer support, etc.

text: Supports canary deployments, running a new release on separate containers and gradually shifting real traffic to it
quote: Bland supports canary deployments — a way to run a new release on a separate set of containers alongside your production infrastructure and gradually route real traffic to it.

text: Pathway nodes can use fixed sentences or dynamic prompting and execute webhooks at any conversation point
quote: Give your agent instructions on how it should respond at specific points of the conversation. Choose between prompting or fixed sentences. Execute webhooks at any point during the conversation

text: Uses JWT signatures with a public JWKS endpoint to verify requests without storing secrets
quote: JWT signatures eliminate these risks through asymmetric cryptography - you verify requests using our public JWKS endpoint without storing any secrets
